visuals.after_heading: How to close the gap without a software overhaul
visuals.headline: Four steps to close the tracking gap

items.title: Pick three numbers
items.text: Coverage, sharpest drop-off and no-decision losses first

items.title: A weekly 15 minutes
items.text: Same three to five numbers in a shared scorecard

items.title: One owner per metric
items.text: Nobody owns it, nobody notices it's missing

items.title: Revisit quarterly
items.text: Add the next metric once the first three are reliable

visuals.source: Source: SocialSprint analysis of the Belkins 2026 survey
visuals.alt: Four steps to close the pipeline tracking gap: pick three numbers, review weekly, one owner per metric, revisit quarterly.
